title: Learning to learn mathematics
scope: Learning to learn mathematics: notation, equality, reading a problem, estimation, diagrams, checking an answer, uncertainty
outcomes: Explain an answer and identify whether a check actually supports it

title: Number and place value
scope: Number and place value: counting, zero, ordering, decimal notation, number line, decomposition
outcomes: Represent and compare numbers in multiple forms

title: Whole-number arithmetic
scope: Whole-number arithmetic: meanings of four operations, properties, algorithms, inverse operations, estimation
outcomes: Solve unfamiliar multi-step arithmetic and explain regrouping

title: Integers and divisibility
scope: Integers and divisibility: negative numbers, order, factors, multiples, primes, gcd/lcm, Euclidean algorithm
outcomes: Use gcd/lcm appropriately and justify elementary divisibility

title: Fractions
scope: Fractions: equal parts, number-line interpretation, equivalence, comparison, operations, mixed numbers
outcomes: Explain why common denominators work and transfer across representations

title: Decimals, percentages, ratios, rates, proportions, scaling
scope: Decimals, percentages, ratios, rates, proportions, scaling
outcomes: Distinguish additive from multiplicative comparison and solve new ratio contexts

title: Powers and roots
scope: Powers and roots: integer exponents, scientific notation, roots, rational exponents with domains
outcomes: Apply exponent laws with correct restrictions and reject invalid cancellations

title: Elementary geometry and measurement
scope: Elementary geometry and measurement: length/area/volume, angles, triangles, congruence, similarity, coordinates
outcomes: Construct a geometric argument, state assumptions, and explain scale factors

title: Data, counting, and chance
scope: Data, counting, and chance: representations, mean/median, sample spaces, simple probability, independence intuition
outcomes: Explain a misleading graph and enumerate a small sample space

title: Algebra I
scope: Algebra I: expressions, substitution, distributivity, equations/inequalities, systems, absolute value
outcomes: Solve and check equations, including exceptional and extraneous cases

title: Functions
scope: Functions: domain/codomain/range, composition, inverse conditions, graphs, piecewise functions, transformations
outcomes: Interpret functions as mappings and compare formula with domain

title: Algebra II
scope: Algebra II: polynomials, factoring, rational functions, quadratics, complex numbers, exponential/logarithmic functions
outcomes: Solve equations with domain tracking and use complex arithmetic

title: Euclidean and coordinate geometry
scope: Euclidean and coordinate geometry: axioms, constructions, circles, vectors in the plane, loci, elementary proofs
outcomes: Write a short geometric proof and identify a missing hypothesis

title: Trigonometry
scope: Trigonometry: unit circle, radians, identities, inverse functions, equations, triangle applications
outcomes: Derive an identity and state branch/range restrictions

title: Sequences and discrete reasoning
scope: Sequences and discrete reasoning: arithmetic/geometric sequences, sums, recursion, binomial theorem, counting
outcomes: Compare recursive and explicit descriptions; avoid double counting

title: Introductory calculus
scope: Introductory calculus: limits conceptually, derivative, integral, fundamental theorem, applications
outcomes: Connect rates, areas, and functions; distinguish numerical evidence from proof

title: Sets, logic, and mathematical language
scope: Sets, logic, and mathematical language: connectives, implication, quantifiers, relations, functions, equivalence
prerequisite_summary: S01–S02; can be taken alongside S03
outcomes: Negate quantified statements and explain necessary/sufficient conditions

title: Proof methods
scope: Proof methods: direct proof, contrapositive, contradiction, induction, cases, existence/uniqueness, counterexample
outcomes: Produce complete proofs and diagnose invalid proof steps

title: Mathematical writing
scope: Mathematical writing: definitions, theorem statements, lemma use, citations, proof structure, revision
outcomes: Submit a revised proof portfolio with explicit hypotheses and reviewer feedback

title: Computational linear algebra
scope: Computational linear algebra: systems, elimination, matrices, determinants, eigenvalues, geometric transformations
outcomes: Solve a system and explain rank, nullity, and geometry

title: Proof-based linear algebra
scope: Proof-based linear algebra: fields, vector spaces, bases, dimension, linear maps, duality, inner products, spectral theorem in stated settings
outcomes: Prove rank-nullity and distinguish real symmetric from arbitrary matrices

title: Real analysis I
scope: Real analysis I: ordered completeness, sequences, limits, continuity, compactness on the real line, differentiation, Riemann integration
outcomes: Construct epsilon arguments and prove a theorem using completeness

title: Real analysis II
scope: Real analysis II: series of functions, uniform convergence, interchange conditions, metric spaces, multivariable rigor
outcomes: Give a counterexample to an invalid interchange of limit and integral

title: Multivariable calculus and forms bridge
scope: Multivariable calculus and forms bridge: partial derivatives, inverse/implicit function intuition, integration, vector calculus, introductory differential forms
outcomes: Relate a local computation to a carefully stated integral theorem

title: Abstract algebra I
scope: Abstract algebra I: groups, subgroups, homomorphisms, quotients, group actions, Lagrange, isomorphism theorems
outcomes: Build a quotient and prove it is well-defined

title: Abstract algebra II
scope: Abstract algebra II: rings, ideals, polynomial rings, domains, fields, extensions, introductory Galois theory
outcomes: Analyze an extension and distinguish reducibility from solvability

title: Point-set topology
scope: Point-set topology: topological spaces, bases, continuity, product/quotient topology, separation, compactness, connectedness
outcomes: Prove a compactness result and produce a non-metric example

title: Complex analysis
scope: Complex analysis: holomorphic functions, Cauchy theory, power/Laurent series, residues, conformal maps
outcomes: Prove a basic holomorphic theorem and justify a contour computation

title: Elementary number theory
scope: Elementary number theory: congruences, CRT, arithmetic functions, Diophantine equations, reciprocity introduction
outcomes: Solve a new congruence problem and explain all solutions

title: Combinatorics and graph theory
scope: Combinatorics and graph theory: enumeration, recurrences, generating functions, graphs/trees, extremal and probabilistic introductions
outcomes: Prove a counting identity by two methods and analyze a graph invariant

title: Probability foundations
scope: Probability foundations: random variables, expectation, distributions, conditional probability, convergence intuition
outcomes: Explain conditioning and distinguish independence from disjointness

title: Differential equations and dynamical systems bridge
scope: Differential equations and dynamical systems bridge: existence/uniqueness intuition, linear systems, phase portraits, stability
prerequisite_summary: S07, U01; U03 for rigorous units
outcomes: Explain what a numerical trajectory can and cannot establish

title: Mathematical logic and foundations I
scope: Mathematical logic and foundations I: formal languages, propositional/first-order logic, soundness/completeness introductions, sets, cardinality
outcomes: Distinguish semantic truth from formal derivability

title: Measure and integration
scope: Measure and integration: sigma-algebras, measures, measurable functions, Lebesgue integration, convergence theorems, product measures
outcomes: Apply dominated/monotone convergence with every hypothesis checked

title: Algebraic topology I
scope: Algebraic topology I: homotopy, fundamental group, van Kampen, covering spaces, homology introduction
outcomes: Compute an invariant and justify its construction

title: Differential geometry I
scope: Differential geometry I: smooth manifolds, tangent/cotangent spaces, maps, forms, integration, Stokes
outcomes: Translate coordinate calculations into an invariant statement

title: Functional analysis introduction
scope: Functional analysis introduction: normed/Banach/Hilbert spaces, bounded maps, Hahn–Banach, compact operators
outcomes: Prove continuity of an operator and analyze completeness

title: Commutative algebra introduction
scope: Commutative algebra introduction: modules, localization, Noetherian rings, prime ideals, tensor products
outcomes: Construct a localization or tensor product and use its universal property

title: Representation theory introduction
scope: Representation theory introduction: group representations, invariant subspaces, characters of finite groups
outcomes: Decompose a small representation with appropriate hypotheses

title: Algebraic number theory introduction
scope: Algebraic number theory introduction: number fields, integers, ideals, ramification introduction
outcomes: Explain why elements and ideals have different factorization behavior

title: Set theory and computability
scope: Set theory and computability: ordinal/cardinal arithmetic, choice, computability, undecidability, incompleteness introduction
outcomes: State an undecidability result precisely without overgeneralizing it

title: Geometry enrichment
scope: Geometry enrichment: projective, affine, non-Euclidean and discrete geometry; axiomatic comparison
prerequisite_summary: S04, U02, P02; U08 for advanced units
outcomes: Compare which conclusions depend on which geometric axioms

title: Undergraduate synthesis seminar
scope: Undergraduate synthesis seminar: theorem exposition, cross-field problems, formalization, oral explanation
outcomes: Defend a proof portfolio and solve an unfamiliar multi-subject problem

title: Measure theory and real analysis
scope: Measure theory and real analysis: measure construction, signed measures, Radon–Nikodym, differentiation, Lp spaces
outcomes: Prove a convergence or representation result and analyze failed hypotheses

title: Functional analysis
scope: Functional analysis: weak topologies, duality, uniform boundedness, open mapping, spectral/operator theory
outcomes: Construct operator examples and present a substantial theorem proof

title: Complex analysis and Riemann surfaces
scope: Complex analysis and Riemann surfaces: analytic continuation, normal families, meromorphic functions, surfaces
outcomes: Explain local/global distinctions through a proof and example

title: Fourier and harmonic analysis
scope: Fourier and harmonic analysis: Fourier transforms, distributions, Lp estimates, introductory singular integrals
outcomes: Establish a bound and specify the function space and convergence mode

title: PDE foundations
scope: PDE foundations: distributions, Sobolev spaces, weak solutions, elliptic/parabolic/hyperbolic examples
outcomes: Distinguish weak/classical solutions and justify an energy argument

title: Graduate algebra
scope: Graduate algebra: modules, structure theorems, field/Galois theory, multilinear algebra, categories
outcomes: Prove a structural result through a universal property

title: Commutative algebra
scope: Commutative algebra: localization, dimension, integral dependence, primary decomposition, homological tools
outcomes: Relate a local algebraic property to a geometric example

title: Homological algebra
scope: Homological algebra: complexes, exactness, derived functors, Ext/Tor, spectral sequences introduction
outcomes: Compute a derived functor and justify the resolution used

title: Algebraic geometry
scope: Algebraic geometry: affine/projective varieties, schemes, sheaves, morphisms, divisors, cohomology introduction
outcomes: Work through an explicit scheme example and an abstract argument

title: Algebraic topology
scope: Algebraic topology: homology/cohomology, exact sequences, CW complexes, fibrations, spectral sequences
outcomes: Compute an invariant with a complete chain-level justification

title: Differential topology
scope: Differential topology: transversality, degree, Morse theory, bundles, cobordism introduction
outcomes: Explain a genericity argument with precise smoothness assumptions

title: Riemannian geometry
scope: Riemannian geometry: connections, curvature, geodesics, comparison and global theorems
outcomes: Derive a coordinate formula and present its invariant interpretation

title: Lie groups and representation theory
scope: Lie groups and representation theory: Lie algebras, exponential map, compact groups, highest-weight introduction
outcomes: Connect algebraic representation data to geometric group structure

title: Algebraic number theory
scope: Algebraic number theory: local/global fields, valuations, ideals, units, class groups, local extensions
outcomes: Analyze arithmetic using local and global methods

title: Analytic number theory
scope: Analytic number theory: Dirichlet series, zeta/L-functions, prime distribution, sieve/introduction to modular forms
outcomes: Derive an estimate and identify analytic-continuation assumptions

title: Arithmetic geometry introduction
scope: Arithmetic geometry introduction: elliptic curves, arithmetic of schemes, modular connections
outcomes: Reproduce a standard curve computation and explain its limitations

title: Extremal/probabilistic combinatorics
scope: Extremal/probabilistic combinatorics: graph bounds, random constructions, concentration, additive methods
prerequisite_summary: U11, U12; G18 for measure-based units
outcomes: Present a rigorous existence argument and a sharpness example

title: Measure-theoretic probability
scope: Measure-theoretic probability: conditional expectation, martingales, convergence, stochastic processes introduction
outcomes: Prove a probabilistic result with the correct sigma-algebras

title: Mathematical logic
scope: Mathematical logic: model theory, proof theory, computability, set theory as separate selectable strands
outcomes: State and prove a selected metatheorem under its formal assumptions

title: Category theory
scope: Category theory: functors, natural transformations, limits, adjunctions, Yoneda; advanced categorical methods
prerequisite_summary: G06 or U08/U16 with proof maturity
outcomes: Use an adjunction or universal property in a concrete subject

title: Dynamical systems and ergodic theory
scope: Dynamical systems and ergodic theory: invariant measures, ergodic theorems, symbolic dynamics
outcomes: Distinguish topological, measurable, and numerical claims

title: Graduate topics seminars
scope: Graduate topics seminars
prerequisite_summary: Published prerequisite skills for each topic
outcomes: Read, reproduce, critique, and present a specialist paper or chapter

title: Literature search and source evaluation
scope: Literature search and source evaluation
prerequisite_summary: Selected advanced pathway and expert-supervised research scope.
outcomes: Annotated bibliography distinguishing textbooks, published papers, preprints, surveys, and corrections

title: Reading a mathematical paper
scope: Reading a mathematical paper
prerequisite_summary: Selected advanced pathway and expert-supervised research scope.
outcomes: Dependency map of definitions/lemmas; reconstructed proof of a central step; list of gaps in understanding

title: Reproduction and formalization
scope: Reproduction and formalization
prerequisite_summary: Selected advanced pathway and expert-supervised research scope.
outcomes: Checked reproduction of a known result or computation; environment and assumptions recorded

title: Problem formation
scope: Problem formation
prerequisite_summary: Selected advanced pathway and expert-supervised research scope.
outcomes: Precise bounded question, examples/nonexamples, relationship to known results, and a mentor-reviewed scope

title: Experimental mathematics
scope: Experimental mathematics
prerequisite_summary: Selected advanced pathway and expert-supervised research scope.
outcomes: Reproducible computational notebook; explicit separation of observations, conjectures, and proofs

title: Seminar and writing
scope: Seminar and writing
prerequisite_summary: Selected advanced pathway and expert-supervised research scope.
outcomes: Expository article, oral presentation, questions addressed, revised proof portfolio

title: Supervised exploratory project
scope: Supervised exploratory project
prerequisite_summary: Selected advanced pathway and expert-supervised research scope.
outcomes: Research log, failed approaches, partial results, uncertainty, and supervisor feedback

scope: Direct addition and subtraction

title: Five-complements
scope: Five-complements

title: Ten-complements and carry/borrow
scope: Ten-complements and carry/borrow

outcomes: Use pairs summing to ten; carry and borrow across rods; explain the numerical invariant

title: Combined complements and multi-digit arithmetic
scope: Combined complements and multi-digit arithmetic
prerequisite_summary: Numeracy plus preceding abacus units; see unit-specific prerequisites.

title: Multiplication
scope: Multiplication

title: Division
scope: Division

outcomes: Quotient placement, remainder interpretation, single then multi-digit divisors, checking by multiplication

title: Decimals and percentages
scope: Decimals and percentages
prerequisite_summary: Numeracy plus preceding abacus units; see unit-specific prerequisites.
outcomes: Fixed radix positions, exact finite decimal operations, proportional reasoning

scope: Mental abacus/anzan introduction

outcomes: Visualize short bead states after physical/virtual competence; fade visual support gradually
